ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 放学后要重新考试。数学

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……感觉似乎有点好玩呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 真的很快就来了。跟有咲说的一样

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不要紧。仔细听鼓的声音。
试试看

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
老师……吗？
我也有一种在学习的感觉。很开心啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 百合学姐。很帅气啊……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我倒是很喜欢香澄那种节奏有点快的演奏呢。
因为她把雀跃的心情都传达出来了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 出售面包……之类的？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 能把糖做成自己喜欢的形状

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 香澄形状的糖人……要做吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 走吧。这是首先要做的事情

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 是就点头，不是就摇头

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 因为祭典取消了，大家都很伤心

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 米歇尔里面的人应该也很伤心

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不知道取消的理由是什么

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 悲伤的现实在等着我们

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 香澄像仓鼠一样。鼓着腮帮子

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 没办法啊。做我们力所能及的事情吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我们自己制作糖人吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
有咲好厉害。
对方的心情了如指掌

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我也想吃Popipa糖人。
如果可以的话，我还想吃有咲糖人

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 走吧。这是首先要做的事情

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 是就点头，不是就摇头

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_012

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 不知道取消的理由是什么

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_015
